history.period: Described as one of the oldest temples in Siliguri (verify antiquity)
history.summary: The Shri Balaji Mandir at Naya Bazaar, Khalpara (geocoder: Nehru Road, Ward No 7, Khalpara, Siliguri 734005) is described in travel sources as one of the oldest temples in Siliguri, dedicated to Lord Hanuman - locally called Balaji. The main sanctum holds idols of Lord Ram and Goddess Sita with Lord Hanuman, and the temple is known for its evening aarti's spiritual ambience. Devotees from across India visit to seek Hanuman's blessings; Tuesdays and Saturdays are the especially revered days. The CSV name 'Balaji Temple (Hanuman Temple)' matches this shrine; Justdial rates it 4.7 (43 ratings). ANTIQUITY FLAG: 'one of the oldest temples in Siliguri' is per travel blogs only - no founding date found in consulted sources; verify locally.
